values: Saqeel MVP1 — Claude Design Approval Pack V3 · Approved Shared Shell
Web-first design programme with a frozen, implemented role-scoped shell and mandatory vertical-slice certification

V3.1 closure: sponsor accepted the functioning TASK-WEB-SHELL-001 shared shell on 2026-07-13. Typecheck and production build PASS; targeted shell Playwright 10/10; visual capture 4/4 including persona setup; complete regression 41/41. All 43 prompts retain their shell family and all 22 business tabs retain a governed disposition. The shell is frozen for Web-first CD-020–031. CD-002 is manually sponsor-approved; Claude Code implementation outcome still requires independent wiring verification. No commit, push, merge, deploy or main modification was performed.
Claude Design must document primary-source principles, adoption and rejection before composing the final screen.
CD-001 remains the baseline for Arabic-first RTL, themes, typography, focus, public-safe maps and magenta-violet identity.
Submit CD-020–027 as WEB-I, then CD-028–031 as WEB-II. CD-032 Operations follows; Admin is deferred.
Require meaningfully different information architectures, a comparison and an evidence-backed selection—not cosmetic variants.
Sponsor signoff sets DESIGN_APPROVED. It does not authorize a completion claim or prove backend behavior.
Map every action and state from UI through validation, server action, data/RPC/storage, RLS, transition, audit, side effect and test.
Claude Code may implement only after wiring gaps are resolved and implementation is explicitly authorized on a safe non-main branch/worktree.
Require real runtime evidence for happy, negative, partial-failure, security, audit, Arabic/RTL, theme, responsive and accessibility paths.
V3 foundation: page ambition rises while global shell truth stays fixed

All 43 prompts now identify their shell family. Web/Admin screens reuse the implemented Saqeel shell; field and virtual channels keep dedicated navigation; access screens remain shell-free. Claude Design must spend its ambition on the inspection decision, object continuity, provenance, consequence and recovery—not on inventing a new sidebar. Unsupported Analytics, Lookup, Notification Configuration, Integration and AI tabs remain hidden until governed runtime behavior exists.

values: V3 Design Rubric — Ambition, Research, Shell Coherence and Build Truth
All requirements, critical states and truth labels traced.
The object model, provenance, version, state, scope and consequence are inspection-plausible.
3+ primary sources; adoption and rejection recorded; no visual copying.
Three meaningfully different task models compared; chosen model proves the 30-second decision and passes the no-brand genericity test.
One interaction measurably reduces cognitive work, reveals causality or prevents irreversible error.
Arabic-first RTL, mixed-direction data, keyboard/focus/screen reader, dark/light, reflow and reduced motion evidenced.
Exact files and WIRING_MAP; every backend leg exists or is HANDOFF_BLOCKED; no invented success.
Advance to sponsor design review only—not implementation completion.
Core and negative paths complete; small evidence items tracked.
Credible objects and consequences with named hard cases.
Primary research supports the selected pattern but comparison is incomplete.
Distinctive hierarchy and task model; one composition alternative needs stronger rejection logic.
Useful signature behavior with a minor state or recovery gap.
Major AR/RTL/a11y/theme/responsive states evidenced; small verification gap remains.
File map is exact; one non-critical wiring leg needs proof.
Accept with named P0/P1 condition and wiring block.
Primary path covered; negative/partial states incomplete.
Usable but weakly contextual or consequence-poor.
References are secondary, generic or not tied to decisions.
Polished standard pattern; variants are cosmetic; genericity test fails.
Signature is a label or decoration, not a task improvement.
Arabic is mirrored late; focus/reflow/status behavior remains unclear.
Handoff maps UI files but not server/data/RLS/audit/tests.
Return for focused revision before sponsor review.
Objects present; state and acceptance coverage weak.
Could belong to any workflow product.
Pattern name-dropping or copied visual language.
Cards/tables/dashboard assembled without a task model.
Invented handlers/data or UI-only completion language.
Requirements, permissions, immutability or truth missing.
Misrepresents inspection, workflow, evidence or provider behavior.
No defensible research or copied product design.
Interaction creates error or hides consequence.
Weakens RLS/guards/audit, exposes raw errors or claims non-existent side effects.

Grade 5 requires evidence, not polish. A visually elegant screen fails if it is generic, research is decorative, Arabic is mirrored late, or backend gaps are disguised as implementation. V3 adds shell coherence: authenticated Web/Admin designs must reuse the approved role-scoped shell; field/virtual/access boundaries must remain distinct; unsupported tabs must stay absent. Ambition belongs in the inspection decision and signature interaction, not a one-off global navigation system. DESIGN_APPROVED is followed by WIRING_AUDIT; only VERTICAL_SLICE_PASS can support a built claim. TASK-WEB-SHELL-001 is sponsor-accepted and frozen; a screen cannot score 5/5 if it redesigns that chrome or changes a governed tab disposition.
